Convert a prepared topic corpus to a data frame

Source: R/accessors.R
as.data.frame.sbert_topic_corpus.Rd

as.data.frame() returns the units of a prepared corpus, one row per unit to be clustered: each document, or each sentence, clause, or phrase when the corpus is segmented. The table shows what topics() and compare_topics() will model, including the segments a segmentation produced and the columns carried from a data frame input.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'sbert_topic_corpus'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

A corpus prepared by topic_corpus().

row.names, optional

Ignored; present for compatibility with the generic.

...

Ignored.

Value

A base data frame with one row per unit and columns document_id, document_name, segment (segmented corpora only), and text, followed by the columns carried from a data frame input.

See also

topic_corpus(), segment().

Examples

documents <- data.frame(
  id = c("a", "b"),
  text = c("Cats chase mice. Stocks and bonds trade.",
           "Dogs chase balls. Markets price shares.")
)
prepared <- topic_corpus(
  documents, column = "text", segment = "sentence",
  embeddings = rbind(c(1, 0), c(0, 1), c(0.9, 0.1), c(0.1, 0.9))
)
as.data.frame(prepared)
#>   document_id document_name segment                    text id
#> 1           1                     1        Cats chase mice.  a
#> 2           1                     2 Stocks and bonds trade.  a
#> 3           2                     1       Dogs chase balls.  b
#> 4           2                     2   Markets price shares.  b
